title: Possible a plaintext secret converted with ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText in source
description: The file contains a plaintext secret converted with ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText. Tool invocations end up in scripts, images and CI logs, which spreads a single committed value across many systems. Shape-only: the match does not prove the credential is live.
remediation: Rotate the credential, replace the inline value with an environment variable or a protected file, and purge the invocation from images, logs and shell history.
limitation: Shape-only: one tool-specific invocation carrying a credential-shaped literal. It cannot prove the credential is live, and it does not resolve values assembled at run time.

tests.line: # the secret is read from the vault cmdlet
